statements.status_notes: GHSA-jh2m-fhpj-3vr7 (RUSTSEC-2026-0486) is about the rustix::fs extended-attribute functions (getxattr, listxattr and their l and f variants) in rustix 1.0.0 through 1.1.5. rustix appears in the SBOM because the Cargo.lock of flux v0.201.0 lists it, but it is not compiled into Kapacitor. Its only dependent in the lock file is tempfile, which flux-core declares as an optional dependency that only its `doc` feature enables. Kapacitor builds libflux with `cargo build --release --no-default-features --features=cffi`, and flux v0.201.0 depends on flux-core with default-features = false, so `doc` is off. The amd64 kapacitord binary contains no symbols from the rustix or tempfile crate, while the crates that are compiled in (anyhow, chrono, libflate, parking_lot_core) do.
